**Status:** Operational board · Monitor v1.0 · binds to RA-CR-2026-08-29  
**Not:** a collapse siren, a live AMOC series, or established science.

This page reads a JSON snapshot written by a public-feed job. Each tile keeps its own vintage. Record SST does not move CL-002 or CL-016.

[Controlling register](book-one-coupling-register.qmd) · [Source snapshot](../assets/monitor/snapshot.json)

## What v1 is allowed to show

| Tile | Feed | Cadence |
|---|---|---|
| Niño 3.4 anomaly | NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP weekly OISST.v2 | Weekly product, fetched daily |
| Extra-polar SST | Locked from the 22 Aug 2026 Copernicus figure in the register | Manual |
| RAPID AMOC | None. Last public array product through Feb 2024 | STALE |
| USGS M≥6 | FDSN event service, 30-day window | Daily |
| Open volcanoes / wildfires | NASA EONET v3 `status=open` | Daily |
| CL-002 / CL-003 / CL-016 / biology | Register gates | Manual |

## What it must not do

- Invent a 2026 Sverdrup number.
- Treat EONET open volcanoes as a synchronized Ring of Fire.
- Fold whale, krill, or phytoplankton die-off into a gauge.
- Compress CL-003 because fire or heat tiles are red.

Refresh is a GitHub Action (`monitor.yml`), not a person staring at the planet.
